normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- 2 Community pools- Private boardwalk to the beach- Central location to shopping and restaurants- 4 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: No Worries is an adorable 4-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom Seagrove Beach cottage that sleeps 10. Guests will love the 2 porches, 2 balconies, spacious interior, 2 community pools, and a private boardwalk that leads to the beach.A cute front porch welcomes guests to No Worries. Stepping inside, they’ll find an impressive open living, dining, and kitchen area with a high vaulted ceiling and a unique brick floor. A spacious primary bedroom with a writing desk and private bathroom is off the entryway. Throughout the home, classic lines and subdued colors create a relaxing, welcoming space for friends and family to gather in. In the living area, 2 sofas and 2 recliners surround a TV, and enjoy views of the back porch. A dry bar separates the open kitchen and dining area from the living space. Guests have lots of room to prepare meals in the L-shaped kitchen and can comfortably dine at a dining table that seats 8 with beautiful views of the wooded backyard. A door off the dining area opens to a fabulous screened back porch with lovely rattan furniture. Yellow accent pillows, a comfortable settee, and a small dining table create an inviting space for late-night chats. Steps lead down from the screened porch to the wooded backyard, where native scrub oaks and palmetto frame additional seating.On the second floor are 3 guest bedrooms that all open to the home’s front and back balconies. A guest bedroom with a queen bed and built-in twin-over-twin bunk beds shares a bathroom with a second guest bedroom. The third guest bedroom has a private bathroom and opens to a large back balcony.Guests enjoy access to 2 fantastic community pools and a private boardwalk that leads to the beach. The private beach walkover is a short stroll away at the end of Chelsea Loop. For public beach access, Eastern Lake is a 6-minute walk. Exploring surrounding Seagrove Beach shops and restaurants is easy on 4 included adult bikes. Book No Worries today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 10):FIRST FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bathroom: Half bathroomSECOND FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed & Twin over Twin Bunk, Shared Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo-Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo*Guests who are 25 years of age or younger must be accompanied by a responsible parent or guardian in any vacation rental managed by Callista by 360 Blue. We do not rent homes to those 25 years of age or younger who are unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian. Moreover, there must be a ratio of at least (1) parent or guardian over the age of 25 for every four (4) young adults who are 25 years of age or younger.*The summer's edge beach access will not be available 1/5/26-2/5/26 due to repairs. During this time the closest beach access available would be the Ramgate beach access.
